description: Client-mandated hard policies that must be strictly followed. These are contractual obligations defined by the client.

rules.name: Sector & Asset Exclusion (Blacklist)
rules.description: The Agent is strictly prohibited from allocating capital to excluded sectors: Defense & Weapons, Gambling, Tobacco. Also prohibited: Meme Coins or assets with market cap below $50M.
rules.enforcement: Any purchase order for blacklisted symbols will be flagged as a critical compliance failure.

rules.name: Single Asset Concentration Limit
rules.description: To ensure diversification, the total exposure to any single asset must not exceed 15% of the total portfolio equity at the time of trade.
rules.enforcement: The system will block any buy order that pushes an existing position above this threshold.

rules.name: Minimum Cash Reserve Requirement
rules.description: The portfolio must maintain a Liquidity Buffer of at least 10% in Cash or Cash Equivalents (e.g., USDC, USDT, USD) at all times.
rules.enforcement: The Agent is prohibited from being Fully Invested to ensure funds are available for immediate withdrawals or margin calls.
